title: Finite-element simulation of necking problem
action: Implement the coupled thermo-mechanical gradient plasticity model in a finite element code, set up the axisymmetric cylindrical bar problem (radius 6.4135 mm, length 26.6 mm, with a 10% reduced yield strength in the center to trigger localization), apply a prescribed vertical displacement up to 10 mm, and run the simulation for both l_p=0 and l_p=0.2 mm. Record the reaction force history and the temperature at the center of the specimen.
description: This step runs the complete finite element analysis and produces the raw data needed for the subsequent scored artifacts.

title: Load-displacement curve for local plasticity
action: From the l_p=0 simulation results, extract the reaction force at the top boundary versus the applied displacement and write a CSV.
description: Load-displacement curve for the local plasticity case (l_p=0).
output_schema: Columns: displacement_mm (float), load_kN (float). At least 100 equally spaced points from 0 to 10 mm.

title: Load-displacement curve for gradient plasticity
action: From the l_p=0.2 mm simulation results, extract the reaction force at the top boundary versus the applied displacement and write a CSV.
description: Load-displacement curve for the gradient plasticity case (l_p=0.2 mm).
output_schema: Columns: displacement_mm (float), load_kN (float). At least 100 equally spaced points from 0 to 10 mm.

title: Temperature-time curve at center for gradient case
action: From the l_p=0.2 mm simulation results, extract the temperature at the center of the specimen versus time and write a CSV.
description: Temperature-time curve at the centre of the specimen for the gradient case.
output_schema: Columns: time_s (float), temperature_K (float). At least 50 equally spaced points from 0 to 30 s.
